question: How do Morgan Stanley and Merrill differ in how they segment clients by wealth tier?

claims.text: Core advisory tier threshold - Merrill: The 2025 10-K (published 2026-02-25) says Merrill Wealth Management's advisory business serves, through its financial advisors, clients with over $250,000 in total investable assets. The BAC 3Q26 deck (published 2026-10-14) also defines Merrill households as those with $250K+ in investable assets, excluding stock plan and banking-only households. Both statements come from Bank of America's GWIM disclosures.
Core advisory tier threshold - Morgan Stanley: not found in the evidence provided (see gaps).

High and ultra-high net worth tier - Merrill: The 2025 10-K (published 2026-02-25) says Bank of America Private Bank, together with Merrill Wealth Management's Private Wealth Management business, targets high net worth and ultra high net worth clients. The BAC 3Q26 deck footnote (published 2026-10-14) defines Private Bank relationships as those with $3MM+ in total balances. On the 3Q26 call (2026-10-14), the CFO cited 470 net new Private Bank relationships with at least $3 million under management.

High and ultra-high net worth tier - Morgan Stanley: The 2025 10-K (published 2026-02-19) says the U.S. Bank Subsidiaries lend to high to ultra-high net worth individuals. It says Wealth Management lending includes tailored lending to ultra-high net worth clients. On the 3Q26 call (2026-10-14), CEO Edward Pick named family office infrastructure solutions for ultra-high net worth clients as part of the firm's capabilities. These sources give no dollar threshold for the tier.

Other segmentation used in reporting - Merrill: On the 3Q26 call (2026-10-14), the CFO reported about 4,200 net new Merrill households with at least $500,000 in assets. The same deck reports about 5K net new $500K+ relationships across Merrill and Private Bank. Bank of America also reports client balances split between Merrill Wealth Management and Bank of America Private Bank (supplement, 2Q26, published 2026-07-14).

Other segmentation used in reporting - Morgan Stanley: On the 1Q25 call (published 2025-04-11), CFO Sharon Yeshaya discussed year-over-year growth in three segments. She named stock plan, self-directed and advisor-led. This is a split by client channel, not by wealth tier, and the chunk gives no asset thresholds.

gaps.what: Morgan Stanley - core advisory tier threshold: the evidence gives no dollar thresholds for Morgan Stanley's wealth tiers. Its filings in the evidence mention high to ultra-high net worth clients only without defining them. A like-for-like comparison of tier cut-offs with Merrill's $250K and $3MM is therefore not possible.
gaps.suggested_source: Morgan Stanley Wealth Management investor-day or strategic-update decks, the Wealth Management financial supplement, or Morgan Stanley's advisor and client-facing web pages describing client tiers

gaps.what: Morgan Stanley - high and ultra-high net worth tier: no asset-level definition is given for this tier.
gaps.suggested_source: Morgan Stanley 10-K business description or investor presentations on the Wealth Management segment
